auroc_finding.statement: This is the first AUROC ever measured on the f-chain, and the first evidence either way on whether the corrected learning-rate anneal moved the classifier.

within_family_comparison.direction: all four external metrics moved in the improving direction

auroc_finding.significance_caveat: The AUROC difference of 0.0192 sits at roughly 1.0 sigma of the combined three-seed spreads (0.0147 and 0.0117); it is directionally consistent across four independent metrics but is not individually significant on seed spread alone.
auroc_finding.threshold_context: 0.843 remains far above the 0.65 target. Separately, the critic acceptance gate requires an absolute AUROC reduction of at least 0.02; the learning-rate correction alone delivered 0.0192, which is the bar an adversarial arm must beat.
